OriginalEnglish: ...And that is precisely what I mean to do.
S-Surely he doesn't mean to<MV>
Don't do it<FG>
Your Majesty<FG>
Back, all of you<FG>
You have your orders. Do not let my efforts be in vain.
Make haste to Mount Neverest, and bring back that weapon<FG>
The future of our peoples, our nations<MV>perhaps even our world<MV>is in your hands.
I am counting on you<FG>
You could have told me to pack my fur coat<FG>
Are we nearly there yet<FH>
How much further till we reach the top<FH>
It shouldn't be too far now...
I'd say we've made it at least halfway.
HALFWAY<FG><FH>
You mean we still have half a mountain to climb<FG><FH>
I-If one of you is trying to scare me with those silly noises, it's not working<FG>
Sounds like it's comin' from under the snow...
Hey...
You don't think it might be...
Monsters<FG>
Well, well... Quite the welcoming committee.
There's so many...
But we've got to get past them<FG>
Look out below<FG>
Magic Burst<FG>
Run along now<FG> And don't come back.
Look out<FG>
Well that was an ‘arrow escape’.
Thanks, Angelo.
I owe you one.
Come now, I merely did what any man would do.
When a gentleman knight sees a damsel in distress...he cannot help but act...
Aaanyway, is everyone alright<FH>
You're not hurt, are you<FH>
Oh, er...n-no.
We're fine, thanks to you.
You saved our bacon. Thank you so much.
It wouldn't have done to climb halfway up Neverest only to end up in the belly of a beast.
We're in your debt.
Think nothing of it.
It is my pleasure to serve such...lovely ladies.
So...this mountain is called ‘Neverest’, is it<FH>
It is, yes...
Why<FH> Haven't you heard of it<FH>
Hmm... Can't say I have.
A thought occurs.
Could it be that somewhere in the course of our travels, we've become stranded together in a strange new land<FH>
Sounds rather...romantic, wouldn't you say<FH>
So ye're the same as ourselves, then<FH>
We're all of us unwittin' visitors from other worlds<FG>
We are<FG>
Other worlds, you say...<FH>
Well, anyway<MV>we're on our way to the top of the mountain, and we're in a bit of a hurry.
What about you two<FH> Got any plans<FH>
If you're at a loose end, you're welcome to tag along with us.
Yes, come with us<FG>
It's easy to get lost on this mountain, even for those who know it well<MV>and we can't just leave you here.
Agreed.
Well, Jessica<FH>
I leave it up to you.
Would you rather accompany our friends here on their journey, or spend some time alone with<MV>
Of course, we'd love to come with you, thanks for asking<FG>
Heh. I understand.
You don't trust yourself to be alone with me.
Yes, yes. Keep telling yourself that.
Right then, everyone<MV>where to next<FH>
Right, sooo...this is the summit.
So it would seem.
But I don't see any ultimate weapons lying around, do you<FH>
Look<FG> Over there<FG>
There's a really weird whiff coming from over there.
I've never smelt anything like it.
Whoa<FG>
'Tis the smell of a legendary weapon, so it is<FG>
Hooray<FG>
Let's goo, goo, goo<FG>
Hey, watch it<FG>
What<FH>
Well, well...
That will be the doorman, if I'm not very much mistaken.
Well, assuming we're not on the guest list,
we'll just have to convince him to let us in.
We really don't have time for this...
But we've got no choice<MV>we'll have to fight him<FG>
Alright<MV>let's polish him off double quick, and bag ourselves that legendary weapon<FG>
The end is nigh, I fear...
Your Radiaaance<FG>
Better late than never.
You have the weapon of legend in your possession<FH>
Then we have not a moment to lose.
You must use it without delay<FG>
Sire<FG>
Here we go...
Right.
The bigger they come, the harder they fall.
Alright, time to finish this<FG>
And with me on your side, the rest will be easy-peasy<FG>
This war is as good as won<FG>
Yeah... You might wanna rethink that...
Look who it is...
Wonderful.
Only a few thousand of them...
We knock one monster down, and a hundred more spring up in its place.
Honestly, when will this war ever end<FH>
When we end it.
Come<MV>let's show them why they should have surrendered.
I am unscathed...
B-But...Tsarevna<FG> Where is Tsarevna<FG><FH>
Kabuff<FG>
Begone with you<FG>
Ts-Tsarevna<FG>
You are unharmed, I hope<FH>
I am<FG> Thank you, Kiryl.
If not for you, I would be thoroughly punctured<FG>
P-Please, Tsarevna<FG>
To deflect your person from damage is only my duty...though your warming words heat me to the very hub<FG>
Kiryl<FG> Now is not time for daydreams<FG>
There are fiends still requiring evisceration<FG>
Y-Yes<FG> Yes, Tsarevna<FG>
Who do you think those two are<FH>
Are they on our side, or<MV>
Sure they are<FG>
That's Alena and Kiryl, so it is<FG>
I do believe it is<FG>
Two of our oldest friends and allies<FG>
Well<FH> Don't just stand there<FG>
We've got a reunion to go to<FG>
Aye, that we do<FG>
Hey, wait<FG>
You should join us.
With Alena and Kiryl by our sides, we are sure to be unstoppable<FG>
Alllright<FG>
Time to get out there and win this war<FG>
Huzzah<FG> We march to victory<FG>
Yeah<FG>
Men<FG> Prepare for battle<FG>
It is time to bring an end to this war, once and for all<FG>
Where am I<FH>
And what am I...doing<FH>
Y-Your Majesty...<FH>
Your Majesty<MV>are you back with us<FH>
What is...
What is the meaning of this...<FH>
Honoured King of Al-Khazam.
Welcome back. We had all but given you up for lost.
Your Radiance<FG>
You conquered Klor and Kadava, and secured their allegiance by force.
You mustered all the armies of the Beastlands,
and marched them through the Great Divide to bring your reign of terror to Ingenia.
You started a second War of Kings, which threatened to rend this peaceful world asunder.
I did these things...<FH>
Much blood has been spilt in your name.
And many lives lost...the King of Harba's among them.
What<FG><FH>
Now, Your Majesty...
You must tell me the truth. What drove you to this madness<FH>
The sword... The moment I took it in my hand...
my heart was filled with hatred, and I was overcome by a thirst for destruction.
And the next thing I remember is being here...
You blame the sword<FH>
Janey Mac<FG>
There's no doubt about it...
'Tis the Sword o' Discord, so it is<FG>
The Sword of Discord<FH>
...Torneko<FH> You know something of this weapon<FH>
Do I know somethin' of it, she asks<FG>
There ain't a weapon in this world or any other Torneko Taloon don't know a little thing or two about<FG>
'Tis an accursed auld blade, so it is.
'Twill make ye strong as anythin', right enough...
but ye'll think o' nothin' but death and destruction till ye get shot of it, or so the legends say.
And sure enough... It seems the legends aren't far wrong...
The sword was a gift<FG> A seer visited my country, and presented it to me as tribute...
A seer<FH>
You don't think<MV>
Could it be the same person who told the Queen of Ingenia what would happen<FH>
Yes.
I'd say that's a very real possibility.
Your Majesty.
Who was this seer<FH> Do you remember anything else about him<FH>
Forgive me, but I have told you all I can.
Beyond this, I know only that I have done an unforgivable wrong, and that I must answer for my crimes.
Because of me, the King of Harba is dead, along with I know not how many others...
By the laws of Al-Khazam, there can be but one punishment<FG>
Not for you<FG>
You think death will absolve you<FH>
You will not escape so easily.
No, you will live on.
You will bear the weight of your responsibility.
Just as I did when my life was spared...
Your Majesty<MV>from this day forth, you will devote yourself wholly to preserving the peace of the Seven Realms.
This will be your lifelong responsibility...and your atonement.
Aye...
Hear me<FI> this war ends here and now.
Let us take this moment to swear that we will never again raise arms against each other.
And let these divided realms be joined together in everlasting peace<FG>
Yeah<FH> Let's GO<FG>
Carver, huh<FH> Never heard of the guy.
Finally, we are having fun<FG>
Come, Alena<FG> Let's dance, dance, dance<FG>
Why, I do believe you're the most beautiful girl in all Accordia.
The mists are clearing<FG>
Meena, what do you behold<FH>
Don't be shy, now<FG>
'Tis all top-quality gear<FG>
What doesn't kill us makes us stronger, eh<FH>
Wow, that smells amazing<FG>
Thanks a lot<FG> I'll be back<FG>
Nice of His Radiance to arrange this party for everyone, eh<FH>
Thank you.
It hardly seems real, does it<FH>
One minute we're all fighting, the next we're all friends again...
Yeah, it's weird.
Peace at last, just like that, eh...<FH>
The King of Harba would... He'd have loved to see it.
He would...
Come on, you two<FG>
Less talking, more dancing<FG>
We must all to celebrate our great victory<FG>
Come, let us gyrate together<FG>
Alriiiiiight<FG> Turn that frown upside down<FG>
First one to bed's a rotten egg<FG>
Hold on<FG> We've got a big day tomorrow.
We don't want to overdo<MV>
Shut up, there's dancing to be done<FG>
Okay, okay<FG>
Maybe just one more bite...
Hey there... You need to wake up.
All that dancing really takes it out of you...
But I'm too tiiiiiired to train...
Huh<FH>
Leave no stone unturned<FG>
Round up every soldier in the city, and order them to<MV>
Hey<FG> Cesar<FG>
What's going on<FH>
Every monster in our army has disappeared.
They were present when the celebrations began, but...
It's not just the Dunisian army.
The monsters of all Seven Realms vanished overnight.
And no one seems to know where they've gone.
N-News from the homeland, Sire...
You're bleeding.
Who did this to you<FH>
Tell me exactly what happened.
My liege... An enormous army of monsters...made a surprise attack on Dunisia...
The company guarding the pyramid fought bravely, but...the odds were too great...
The capital...has fallen<FG>
No<FG>
By the Goddess<FG>
H-Harba... Harba has fallen<FG>
